answer_1.quote: Mental Illness Conditioned Motivational Dialogue Generation (MI-MDG) framework to generate mental illness conditioned sentiment driven Reinforcement Learning (RL) based motivational responses
answer_1.outputs: Generated motivational responses for mental health support.

answer_2.quote: Standard measures, such as the BLEU-1 score, perplexity, ROUGE-L score, and embedding based metric

answer_4.quote: A human evaluation was conducted to analyse the quality of the generated responses from different models. For this, we presented 100 randomly selected conversations to three human users from authors affiliation to rate the quality of the responses on a scale of 1 (worst) to 5 (best) based on three metrics, namely, (i) Fluency : to ensure that the generated response is syntactically or grammatically correct; (ii) Adaptability : to ensure that the response is contextually aligned with what is now being discussed; and (iii) Motivational : The response generated by the VA should be positively-oriented imparting hope and motivation.
answer_4.guideline: Rate the quality of the responses on a scale of 1 to 5 based on Fluency, Adaptability, and Motivational criteria.
